nodes.prompt: Read the exact declared immutable predecessor issue snapshot. Return that complete snapshot unchanged, including body and all fields. Inspect legacy ownership; recovery requires observed stopped evidence. Preserve every transaction, human specification, acceptance criterion and relation. Do not migrate closed goals or broaden discovery.

Prepare an auditable schema-1 to schema-2 conversion for this selected open goal using exact source evidence. Preserve repository, issue, parent, specification, acceptance criteria, priorities, dependencies and blockers. Retain every historical transaction. Restart unfinished work under the current reviewed default graph with empty live leases and no carried approvals; list every fresh obligation. Preserve old custom risk tags in the immutable source; apply current default risk rules to the converted goal. Do not silently mark an obligation satisfied or a goal done. Publish raw target envelope, payload, graph and specification as immutable Git JSON artifacts in administrator-owned artifact storage, with exact commit/path/hash references; do not edit source or rewrite existing provider records. Emit mapped_evidence=[] for a fresh restart. A converted target is only a proposal pending independent review and exact user approval.

Independently read the exact conversion and all referenced immutable artifacts. Check source identity, preserved user text/criteria/relations/history, current default rules, absence of inherited live ownership or fabricated approvals, and the complete list of obligations still requiring fresh evidence. Approve only if no required finding remains; otherwise emit changes_requested. This review grants no human approval or implementation authority.

Present the exact current conversion and approved independent review to the user. Record only actual explicit user approval of that exact conversion; previous execution, default-policy or restart approval is not a substitute. Unanswered approval blocks activation.

Activate only the exact independently approved conversion with its current root approval Result reference, using the returned public submission. Preserve historical records. Activation itself completes no product goal or implementation criterion.
